note: Per-company rNPV inputs replacing the default peak-sales priors. Patient counts and evidence are verbatim quotes from the company's own SEC filings; penetration and net price are analyst assumptions and are labelled as such.

SGMT.asset: denifanstat, oral FASN inhibitor, moderate-to-severe acne (US Phase 3 AURORA, started 2026-10)
SGMT.source: patients: Sagimet 10-K for 2025; penetration and price: analyst assumptions

patients.derivation: 50 million Americans with acne x up to 20% severe = 10 million; the drug targets moderate-to-severe, so this is a floor on the addressable group
quotes: Acne is the most common skin condition in the United States, affecting up to 50 million Americans annually.
the prevalence of severe acne may be as high as 20% of those affected by acne.

SGMT.assumptions: Net price $1,500 a year and 0.5% / 1.5% / 4% share of the 10 million are analyst assumptions for a branded oral acne drug competing with generic antibiotics and isotretinoin; not company guidance.

evidence.quote: In June 2025, Ascletis announced that denifanstat met all primary and secondary endpoints in its Phase 3 trial in moderate to severe acne vulgaris in China.
In December 2025, Ascletis announced that the China NMPA has accepted its NDA for denifanstat for the treatment of moderate to severe acne.

ELDN.asset: Study of Tegoprubart Efficacy and Safety Compared With Tacrolimus in Kidney Transplantation (NCT07835581)
ELDN.source: patients: company 10-K (quote verified); price, covered share and penetration: Sonnet assumptions, unverified

quotes: with an estimated 270,000 Americans living with a transplanted kidney.
patients.indication: Prevention of allograft rejection in kidney transplantation

ELDN.assumptions: Tegoprubart targets new transplant initiations (~25k/yr incidence ≈ 9% of the 270k prevalent base, rounded to 12% to allow modest switch-in of stable patients); $45k/yr anchored to belatacept (Nulojix) with a modest premium for a novel CD40L mechanism; penetration reflects stiff tacrolimus entrenchment at bear, meaningful uptake if Phase 3 superiority on CNI toxicity holds at base, and broad first-line displacement if safety profile proves differentiated at bull.

HURA.asset: Placebo-Controlled Trial of IFx-Hu2.0 Followed By Pembrolizumab In Checkpoint Inhibitor Naïve Participants With Advanced (NCT06947928)
HURA.source: patients: company 10-K (quote verified); price, covered share and penetration: Sonnet assumptions, unverified

patients.derivation: 4,245 (US prevalence, advanced/metastatic MCC, projected 2027) x covered share 60%
quotes: According to DelveInsight, it is estimated by 2027 there will be approximately 4,245 patients in the US and 7,049 patients in the 7 major market European countries, including the UK, growing to a total of 15, 262 patients by 2034 in these geographic territories.
patients.indication: Advanced or metastatic Merkel Cell Carcinoma

HURA.assumptions: Net price benchmarked to avelumab/pembrolizumab monotherapy WAC (~$200K) with a ~8% net discount; addressable share set at 0.60 to reflect the CPI-naïve first-line subset of the advanced/metastatic population; penetration capped by competition from already-approved checkpoint inhibitors (avelumab, pembrolizumab) in this rare indication.

IRD.asset: OPI-NXYDLD-303 Safety and Efficacy of Phentolamine Ophthalmic Solution in Keratorefractive Surgery Participants With Dec (NCT07140783)
IRD.source: patients: company 10-K (quote verified); price, covered share and penetration: Sonnet assumptions, unverified

patients.derivation: 38,000,000 (US prevalence (cumulative post-keratorefractive-surgery population)) x covered share 22%
quotes: Further, according to GlobalData, approximately 38 million patients in the U.S.
patients.indication: Decreased mesopic visual acuity in keratorefractive surgery patients (post-LASIK/PRK night-vision disturbances)

IRD.assumptions: ~22% of post-refractive patients report clinically bothersome mesopic disturbances (label-eligible); net price of ~$1,800/yr reflects a periodic-use branded ophthalmic drop (comparable to Ryzumvi launch pricing with managed-care rebates); penetration is capped by elective/cash-pay dynamics, competition from accommodative strategies, and the fact that many patients self-resolve.

economics.basis: Viatris holds the exclusive license for phentolamine (PS) including night vision disturbances in its territory; IRD receives tiered royalties. 15% is the midpoint of 'low double-digit up to low 20%' (US); ex-US is low double-digit. Royalties end 2040.
quotes: The Company will also receive tiered royalties, starting at low double-digit royalties up to low 20% royalties, based on the aggregate annual net sales of all PS Products in the United States, and will receive low double-digit royalties based on all annual net sales in the Viatris Territory outside of the United States.
The royalty payments will continue on a country-by-country basis from the date of the first commercial sale of the first PS Product in a country of the Viatris Territory until December 31, 2040.

ANTX.asset: Phase 2 Study of Oral Epetraborole in Adults With Polycythemia Vera (NCT07891533)
ANTX.source: patients: company 10-K (quote verified); price, covered share and penetration: Sonnet assumptions, unverified

quotes: PV is estimated to affect approximately 155,000 people in the U.S.

ANTX.assumptions: $90K net price anchored to oral JAK/myeloproliferative agents (below ruxolitinib list ~$150K after rebates); 40% addressable share reflects likely label for hydroxyurea-refractory/intolerant patients; penetration capped by entrenched ruxolitinib use and a Phase 2-stage asset still needing Phase 3 proof.

FATE.source: patients: company 10-K (quote verified); price, covered share and penetration: Sonnet assumptions, unverified

quotes: the prevalence of SSc is greater than 85,000 patients with significant unmet medical need.

FATE.assumptions: Cell therapy one-time infusion priced analogously to oncology CAR-T but discounted for autoimmune (~$300K net); addressable share limited to severe/refractory SSc (~25%); penetration range reflects single-infusion logistics and competitive pressure from emerging small-molecule and biologic entrants.

PALI.asset: A Trial to Investigate PALI-2108 Versus Placebo in Participants With Moderately to Severely Active Ulcerative Colitis (NCT07845487)
PALI.source: patients: company 10-K (quote verified); price, covered share and penetration: Sonnet assumptions, unverified

patients.derivation: 655,317 (US diagnosed prevalent cases (2031 projection, 8MM context)) x covered share 32%
quotes: is again projected to lead in prevalence in 2031 with 655,317 cases, whereas Canada is projected to report the lowest with 91,186 cases.
patients.indication: Ulcerative Colitis (UC) — moderately to severely active

PALI.assumptions: UC advanced therapies (Rinvoq, Zeposia, Entyvio biosimilars) net ~$30–45K; ~32% of prevalent UC is moderately-to-severely active and label-eligible; penetration capped by a crowded market with established biologics and JAK inhibitors, with upside if colonic prodrug delivery shows tolerability advantages.

PRME.asset: A Study of the Safety and Efficacy of Prime Editing (PM647a) in Participants With Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (NCT07887347)
PRME.source: patients: company 10-K (quote verified); price, covered share and penetration: Sonnet assumptions, unverified

quotes: In the United States, approximately 100,000 individuals – many of whom are undiagnosed - have AATD, with PiZZ patients representing the most severe form.

PRME.assumptions: PM647a is a prime-editing corrective targeting the Z allele (PiZZ genotype, ~55% of US AATD); priced as a one-time curative analogous to approved gene therapies (Hemgenix $3.5M, Zynteglo $2.8M) at $3M net; peak penetration capped by high undiagnosed fraction and typical rare-disease gene-therapy uptake curves. One-time gene-editing price: the penetrated pool is treated over 10 years (corrected by hand).
